sections.Profile:
"Diamond Lady" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in February 1988. It features a casino and gambling theme with two flippers, one ramp, and a two-ball multiball mode. Part of the Gottlieb System 80B series, the game was designed by Jon Norris with artwork by Constantino and Jeanine Mitchell. A total of 2,700 units were produced.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
